## New checkpoint: finite Taylor prime detection and exact source transport

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** Three parallel attacks produced an explicit finite detector for the denominator primes of a supplied eventual cycle, an arbitrary-delay rational family with genuinely convergent ordinary shadows, exact denominator clearing along actual jets, and quantitative separation of the actual forward and inverse laws.

The arbitrary-source arithmetic germ and a universally successful paid descent selector remain unconstructed. The finite cycle detector retains eventual periodicity; the source-law comparison retains a hypothetical escaping component.

### 1. A finite, prefix-independent certificate for every reduced-clock prime

For the literal actual germ
\[
J_n(t)=B_n(2+t)=\sum_{j\ge0}c_j(n)t^j,
\]
suppose the orbit is eventually periodic, with shortcut period A and p odd inputs. Put
\[
g=\gcd(A,p),\quad u=A/g,\quad v=p/g,\quad F(z)=z^u-3^v,
\qquad D_{\rm red}=2^u-3^v.
\]
Let C be the complete chronological cycle numerator and R=Res(F,C), a nonzero integer. For every prime ell dividing D_red, the first coefficient whose reduced denominator contains ell satisfies
\[
\boxed{
\delta_\ell\le
\left\lfloor\frac{u\,v_\ell(R)}{v_\ell(D_{\rm red})}\right\rfloor
<u^2(2p-1).
}
\]

The proof uses finite Taylor truncation, algebraic pole distance, and the integer norm. No infinite series is evaluated at a pole. The complete valuation in the reduced clock is retained. Truncated integrality at ell other than two and three is exactly invariant along every actual prefix, so neither bound depends on the preperiod.

Consequently, if a positive ordinary source is already eventually periodic with the supplied A,p and its first u²(2p−1) coefficients all lie in Z[1/3], it reaches one. This does not establish eventual periodicity, a universal period bound, or arbitrary-source rational coefficients.

[Complete theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/research/closure-round7-20261123/FINITE_JET_BOUND.md) · [independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round7/DETECTOR_REVIEW.md).

### 2. Arbitrarily delayed prime five, above any rational orbit floor

For every k>=1 and M>0, the new explicit primitive positive rational cycle family has all its states greater than M and
\[
\boxed{v_5(\operatorname{den}c_j)=\max(0,j+1-k)\quad(j\ge0).}
\]

The family uses W_m=u^(m−1)v with u=1^p 0^(A−p), v=0 1^p 0^(A−p−1), A=3 mod20, p=1 mod20, and m=4 mod5. Hensel digits choose the exact delay; arithmetic-progression approximations to log₂3 raise the complete orbit floor. A full-denominator gcd argument proves every member is nonintegral.

**This delays one specified prime. Other forbidden primes already occur at the constant coefficient.** It supplies no long initial jet entirely in Z[1/3] and no ordinary counterexample.

Every finite prefix also has arbitrarily large positive **ordinary** realizers that reach a power of two and then one. For a shared prefix of length h,
\[
v_2(c_j(n)-c_j(r))\ge h-j\qquad(0\le j\le h).
\]
The construction uses the complete carry and the primitive root two modulo powers of three. Every constructed ordinary germ lies in Z[1/3][[t]], but the ordinary source changes with the horizon. Finite binary approximation does not preserve that arithmetic ring in the rational limit.

[Family, full denominator, and convergent-shadow proofs](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/research/closure-round7-20261123/ORDINARY_DESCENT.md) · [independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round7/DESCENT_REVIEW.md).

### 3. Exact clearing of denominator layers along one actual orbit

If the finite actual jet through order r belongs to Z[1/3], and S_r(n) is its maximum ternary denominator exponent, then
\[
\boxed{S_r(T^Nn)=\max(S_r(n)-p_N,0).}
\]

Each odd step removes exactly one remaining layer; even steps preserve it. Actual binary integrality removes the apparent powers of two in triangular division by 2+t. A positive ternary radius gives S_r=O(r), hence integer jets of increasing order after linearly many **odd** steps, conditional on the original arithmetic germ.

The complete all-order prefix identity is
\[
2^j3^{p_N}c_j(n)-C_j(N)
=2^N\sum_{i=0}^j\binom N{j-i}2^ic_i(T^Nn).
\]
The complete tail, moment heights, and additional valuation costs remain explicit. This does not construct rationality of the first derivative or yield ordinary descent. The actual source 85 retains c₁(85)=0.

[Arithmetic proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/research/closure-round7-20261123/GERM_CONSTRUCTION.md) · [seven public Lean theorems](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/research/closure-round7-20261123/GermConstruction.lean) · [independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round7/GERM_REVIEW.md).

The exact valuation equality and analytic attachment are written proofs. Lean checks finite integer clearing and subring invariance from the actual rational coefficient equations.

### 4. The inverse entrance law separates from the actual forward law

PR177's source-qualified ordinary entrance law, at **3124c03a6a672cb70cdd5604eaf2d4eb19a467e3**, is retained with its full killed-kernel normalization. On a hypothetical escaping component,
\[
\nu_j(n)=r(n)^s1_{\operatorname{Pred}(q_j)}(n)/A_j,\qquad s>1.
\]
Keep the same actual source and forward empirical law pi_N. The earlier entire-orbit count has theta=H₂(log₃2). The new result proves, uniformly over every inverse root j,
\[
\boxed{
1-\operatorname{TV}(\pi_N,\nu_j)
=O\!\left(N^{-(1-\theta/s)}/\sqrt{1+\log N}\right).
}
\]

The proof integrates the counting function of that same forward orbit. It assumes no inverse-basin sparsity. At growing moduli with H_N/Q_N=o(N), the projected total variation also tends to one—on the same scales where complete-quotient forward collision packing tends to zero. The inverse laws retain an ordinary atom and have collision dimension zero; this says nothing about the forward stationary law's dimension.

For j>=N−1, the exact forward trial also has
\[
\operatorname{KL}(\pi_N\Vert\nu_j)
\ge(s/\theta-1)\log N+
\frac{s}{2\theta}\log(1+\log N)-O(1).
\]

Thus inverse entrance-law convergence cannot directly supply the missing forward collision comparison. An additional arithmetic transport must pay its change of law and signed displacement cost. The finite repeated-address compiler control grows at least 1+84(4/3)^k; it is explicitly periodic and is not an escaping-ray counterexample.

[Actual-source theorem and exact constants](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/research/closure-round7-20261123/SOURCE_TRANSFER.md) · [independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round7/TRANSFER_REVIEW.md).

- Lean 4.34.1, compiler **5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52**; Mathlib **d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612**.
- Both compilation commands passed with one worker, warnings as errors, and autoImplicit=false. Axiom union: **propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound**; no sorryAx.
- Normal and optimized exact Python replays passed with **byte-identical output**. All five Python sources use explicit checks; no assert statements are present.
- **15** selected cycle words, **13** exact prime certificates, **15** actual positive rational preperiods, **97** independent prefix coefficient comparisons.
- **68** explicitly convergent ordinary sources, **1,950** actual prefixes, **23,400** full prefix identities and **23,400** exact denominator-clock checks.
- **Five** delayed-prime rational examples, **26,145** literal rational steps. The longest complete cycle has **24,732** states, all above **11**.
- **Two** constructed convergent ordinary shadows, **2,592** complete shortcut steps through one, eight Taylor coefficients each.
- **7,621** exact source-transfer checks, **237** ordinary sources, **35** finite normalized inverse laws, **733** projected cutoff cases, **12** layer-cake identities.
- Four independent written reviews plus [root reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3954c775ba74e1f40776ff38cb4282698d4a334a/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round7/ROOT_REVIEW.md). No mathematical correction was required at the frozen scientific blobs.

The general resultant, five-adic family, arbitrary-floor and shadow theorems, exact valuation equality, and probability asymptotics remain written mathematics. The finite inverse controls use stopped potentials on convergent trajectories. They do not construct an escaping component or verify an infinite asymptotic statement by computation.

The new finite detector removes an unbounded Taylor-order search once a cycle is supplied. It does not solve that source-construction problem.
